name: isopleth-site-scout
description: Tap any U.S. point for flood, soils, terrain, grid, wind, solar and hazard facts, each with its source. A forkable showcase for the Isopleth API on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry

ISOPLETH_KEY.description: Your Isopleth API key. Get one free at https://isopleth.dev/signup/?utm_source=sitescout&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=deploy

POINT_LIMIT_PER_MIN.description: New points per visitor per minute. Shown in the rate-limit message; keep it in step with POINT_LIMITER.

CHECK_THE_LAND_CTA.description: "on" shows a link to Check the Land's buyer's report under the facts. Leave "off" for your own app.
